name: commutative_mul_s
question: Do commuted mul.s source operands or one explicit scalar local change the PCode operand order or virtual-register layout?

variants.name: fresh_times_invariant
variants.intent: Multiplies the freshly named scalar by the invariant-named scalar in source order.

variants.name: invariant_times_fresh
variants.intent: Reverses the same scalar multiplication spelling so the invariant-named scalar appears first.

variants.name: local_fresh_times_invariant
variants.intent: Copies fresh through one volatile float local before the same multiplication, a minimal shape likely to create a distinct virtual register.
